I raised this with them, this is more of an egregious bug:  https://foss.heptapod.net/pypy/pypy/-/issues/3840 

affects sqlalchemy 2.0 only

issue.title: 11 test failures with PyPy3.9 7.3.11 in 2.0.0 (and git main)
issue.body:
### Describe the bug

When running the test suite (as of 6779fa861d11668f67d780d77e4ae76965cee6f7) under PyPy3.9 7.3.11, I get the following test failures:

```
FAILED test/ext/test_associationproxy.py::DictOfTupleUpdateTest::test_update_multi_elem_varg - AssertionError: 'update expected at most 1 arguments?, got 2' !~ dict.update() takes from 0 to 1 positional arguments but 2 were g...
FAILED test/ext/test_associationproxy.py::DictOfTupleUpdateTest::test_update_one_elem_varg - AssertionError: 'dictionary update sequence element #1 has length 5; 2 is required' !~ sequence of pairs expected
FAILED test/ext/test_associationproxy.py::ProxyHybridTest::test_msg_fails_on_cls_access - AssertionError: 'Association proxy received an unexpected error when trying to retreive attribute "B.fails_on_class_access" from c...
FAILED test/dialect/test_sqlite.py::TestTypes_sqlite+pysqlite_3_40_1::test_cant_parse_datetime_message - AssertionError: Exception ValueError("Invalid isoformat string: 'ASDF'") was correctly raised but did not set a cause, within cont...
FAILED test/engine/test_processors.py::PyDateProcessorTest::test_date_invalid_string - AssertionError: Exception ValueError("Invalid isoformat string: '5:a'") was correctly raised but did not set a cause, within conte...
FAILED test/engine/test_processors.py::PyDateProcessorTest::test_datetime_invalid_string - AssertionError: Exception ValueError("Invalid isoformat string: '5:a'") was correctly raised but did not set a cause, within conte...
FAILED test/engine/test_processors.py::PyDateProcessorTest::test_time_invalid_string - AssertionError: Exception ValueError("Invalid isoformat string: '5:a'") was correctly raised but did not set a cause, within conte...
FAILED test/dialect/test_suite.py::ReturningGuardsTest_sqlite+pysqlite_3_40_1::test_delete_single - AssertionError: Callable did not raise an exception
FAILED test/dialect/test_suite.py::ReturningGuardsTest_sqlite+pysqlite_3_40_1::test_insert_single - AssertionError: Callable did not raise an exception
FAILED test/dialect/test_suite.py::ReturningGuardsTest_sqlite+pysqlite_3_40_1::test_update_single - AssertionError: Callable did not raise an exception
FAILED test/base/test_utils.py::ImmutableDictTest::test_pep584 - AttributeError: 'super' object has no attribute '__ror__'. Did you mean: '__dir__'?
```

Some of them might be valid bugs in PyPy; I can pass the report on to PyPy developers if you wish.

### To Reproduce

```python
tox -e pypy3  # ;-)
```
